svg.title: Beyond Code page desktop wireframe
svg.desc: Wireframe of the Beyond Code page: navigation, an animated headline, and a four-column bento grid. A large movie ticket tile and a large Boston photo tile fill the top two rows. Below are an On the court tile, a From the stands tile, a tall Quick stats tile, a Tinkering tile, and a wide Hackathons and events tile, then a footer.
svg.text: Movies, sports, and life in Boston.
The people, the weather, the greenery
Runs along the Charles and Fenway Fens
Hackathons hosted by Red Hat and IBM
